lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: SHE'S LOCKING THE ENTIRE SCHOOL DOWN [beat] JUST TO FIND A STUPID BLUE FOLDER!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Attention students, this is not a drill, nobody [beat] leaves this building until I see that blue plastic in my hands right now!

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: Nix, if she finds us with this, we aren't just getting suspended, we are going to [beat] straight-up juvenile detention for theft!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: We need to hide it in the vent, but the janitor's closet is already [beat] crawling with those security guards she hired today!

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: Move over, you losers, I know a back way through the cafeteria that the cameras [beat] can't even see during a full building lockdown!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: I know you're in the south hallway, Nix, and I can smell the [beat] pathetic desperation coming off your cheap sneakers from here!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Going somewhere? The Principal said whoever catches you gets a [beat] guaranteed pass for the rest of the semester, so come here!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: You’re really going to sell us out for a math grade, Bruno, you absolute [beat] spineless lizard of a human being?

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: The lockdown bypassed the fire alarms, guys, she's literally [beat] trapping us in here like we're in some twisted horror survival game!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Five minutes until I start searching every single locker individually, and I promise [beat] the consequences will be life-altering for everyone!

lines.speaker: ding
lines.text: The folder isn't even about grades, Nix, I just saw a page and it's [beat] a list of every teacher's home address and private bank codes!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: This isn't a school record, it's a [beat] blackmail file, and she's ready to burn this entire place down just to keep it quiet!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Found you! Now give me the folder before I call the [beat] real police to handle you little thieves once and for all!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: If I'm going down, I'm taking the whole school's [beat] dirty laundry with me, so watch what happens when I hit the global send button!
